recommended.boundary: normal path; prompts avoid putting secrets in argv or shell history

automation.boundary: read API token from stdin; keep secret out of argv
read OAuth client secret from stdin; keep secret out of argv
acceptable for secret-manager injected automation; do not hard-code in shell history or source

avoid.boundary: accepted for compatibility, but secrets in argv can be exposed through shell history or local process inspection
direct echo/printf writes can leak through shell history and create files before permissions converge; prefer tslink login stdin paths

storage.boundary: preferred storage: macOS Keychain, Linux Secret Service, or Windows Credential Manager
headless fallback uses user-only restricted files when keychain storage is unavailable

high_risk_operations.boundary: default login does not rewrite shared tailnet ACL policy
default serve does not rewrite shared tailnet ACL policy
requires destructive confirmation and explicit remote ACL opt-in

detail.description: macOS only. TSLink-authored explanation kept separate from launchctl_output; present for already_absent and unconfirmed domain-state remedies.

force_risk.description: macOS failure only. Residual daemon risk accepted by running force_command.

path.description: Linux and Windows only. Path to the platform startup artifact inspected or removed by this invocation.

removed.description: Whether the platform startup artifact was removed by this invocation.

service_manager.description: Linux and Windows only. Platform startup mechanism responsible for the artifact.

unavailable_domain.description: macOS failure only. The unavailable launchd domain, such as gui/501, when error.code is launchctl_domain_unavailable.

warning.description: Actionable non-fatal warning on a successful forced removal; omitted on failures and when no warning applies.
